[[Sadi's Benediction]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Commander Sadi-Belai]], a [[boss]] in [[Forum Highlands]].

==Stats ==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Holy damage|Holy Dmg]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Protection Prayers]])
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer
:Energy +5 ([[while Enchanted]])

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Divine Staff]] [[dye]]d white.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*[[Protective Staff]] from collectors [[Kaya (collector)|Kaya]], [[Akom]], or [[Snap Flamekrak]] or crafter [[Ruricu]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]]
*Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Enchanting]]
OR
*One of the following Protection Prayers staves:
**[[Protective Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Divine Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Charr Staff]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Staff]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Staff]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Staff]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*Perfect Insightful Staff Head
*Perfect Staff Wrapping of Enchanting 
*Perfect "Have Faith" [[inscription]]

==Unique counterpart==
*[[Madruk's Prophecy]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Chaos damage]] and requires [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].

==Trivia==
The white color of the stick cannot be replicated in a [[Divine Staff]] using a white [[dye]] nor combinations of it, since the resulting pattern is different for the [[unique]] counterpart.
